hints.title: Energy Constrained Traversal
hints.text: Each movement step costs unit energy, while stepping onto an energy station replenishes capacity back to the maximum.

hints.title: Litter Bitmask Tracking
hints.text: Track collected litter locations using a bitmask of size k.

hints.title: Breadth-First State Search
hints.text: Search over tuples (r, c, energy, mask) to identify the minimal move count when the mask reaches zero.
